Initial release of protocol-intelligence skill.

- Introduces Protocol Intelligence Briefs: structured, actionable research briefs on AI governance, decentralized coordination, and emerging technology standards.
- Defines a consistent brief format with sections for executive summary, technical landscape, competitive map, regulatory signals, strategic implications, watch list, and cited sources.
- Outlines four core research domains: AI Governance & Safety, Multi-Agent Protocol Standards, Blockchain & Decentralized AI Infrastructure, and Organizational & Institutional Design.
- Details a step-by-step research method to ensure clarity, specificity, and strategic utility.
- Sets quality standards for actionable, well-sourced, and opinionated analysis—avoiding vague or indecisive briefs.
